name: reelclaw
description: Make TikTok/Reels UGC ads for the product in your repo with real human reaction hooks from DansUGC. Volume mode renders many variations on the hosted ReelClaw engine; studio mode edits 1-5 polished ads locally with HyperFrames templates and a look-at-the-frames QA loop. No API keys: log in with your DansUGC account (OAuth). Needs a Growth or Scale plan; editing is included, you pay only for clips and research queries.
